name: Lantern Harbor
description: Lanterns sway above tide-worn steps. A market lies north; a shrine glows to the east.

name: Night Market
description: Stalls of oil, wick, and glass crowd the square.

name: Tide Shrine
description: Warm light pools around a stone basin of seawater.

name: Wind Cliffs
description: Gulls wheel over a cave mouth that breathes cold air.
